main_text.head: ACTVS PRIMVS.
ABRAHAMVS.
main_text.p: X quo reliƈtis finibus patria, Ɛagor Modo hùc, modo illuc, quis, precor, mortalium Maiore iactatur malorum turbine, Ɛitámque per plura trahit anxius mala? Ɛed, ó suprema sedis arbiter Deus, Quicunque me casus fatiget inquies, Quis Ɛiuit Ɛsqnam me beatior? Manu Cui largiore plura commodas bona, Ex quo tuum sequutus imperium Ɛolens Natale protinus folum fugi, & domus Limen paterna, & arua quaspecu inferi Prognatus obumbrat Error, & quibus colunt Plebes profana fabricata Numina? Sic prosperis aduersa rebus temperas, Tuosque Ɛbique per Ɛarias feruans neces, Quam sis parens benignus indicas satis Superque cunctis: & Ɛelut ex nihilo omnia Nutu creasti fortiore, sic soles Mutare bono malum, & tenebras lumine, Vt qua tuam sereniore tempore Humana gens benignitatem non Ɛidet, Hanc liberata tot periclis sentiat, Et robur alma laudet Ɛsque dextera.

page.notes: Several words in the verse are set in a difficult or worn type and are only partly legible; forms such as "Ɛagor", "Ɛitámque", "Ɛed", "Ɛiuit", "Ɛbique", "Ɛarias", "Ɛelut", "Ɛidet" and "Ɛsque" are doubtful readings of the printed long-s/tall forms and are unverified. "Maiore iactatur" and "quaspecu" may contain errors. The reference mark-free verse is transcribed as printed in lines, joined into one paragraph.
